title: A War between Humans and AI
description: On an unknown continent, there is a city called Satellite City No. 9. In this city, a screw straightening worker named Rui Li at the screw factory gradually realizes the unreality of the city in her monotonous daily work. With the help of a mysterious character named "Anull", Rui Li gains the superpower of "transformation" and becomes the thief "Sirius", secretly taking action to escape from here. When the truth of the world finally unfolds before her eyes, Rui Li discovers that her real battle has just begun.

title: Wo de ai shen
description: Friends since childhood, Lee and Wong grow up together, live in the same neighborhood, go to the same school and now work for the same employer. In family life, they are poles apart. Wong has been married to Mary for eight years while Lee is a happy-go-lucky bachelor. In fact, Lee envies Wong for his happy marriage and Wong wants to have Lee's freedom. When Nancy leaves Hong Kong for a long assignment in the United States, then, Wong tries to take Lee out of his gloom, saying the world is full of pretty women. So, Lee meets and goes after air stewardess Susie who is very feminine. But she too recoils away from the suggestion of marriage. Lee suspects she has a lover.

title: Ai qing ling yao
description: A web of connected stories on adventure, sex, and love in Taiwan, including a 17 y.o. boy with a porn obsession, three hoodlums, and a self-righteous police officer.

title: AI Romantic
description: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires. She even has a crush on her master Ka-lim and understands the meaning of love. Top management member and also romantic rival Sister Dorian (Crystal Fung) keeps going after Bo at all times as she is determined to eradicate her. Meanwhile, Bo detects some computer bug has hit her. Her life is coming to an end.

title: Ai Tenchi Muyo! [English] S1-S4
description: A reboot of the Tench Muyo anime In TV short form. The Series takes place in the city of Takahashi, the real-life sponsor of the show.

title: AI Women’s Wrestling Just Hit Another Level | Nyx & Astra Backstage Brawl
description: Two rivals. One hallway. Zero rules. Nyx Vale and Astra Devi collide backstage in an intense AIW women’s division fight that turns a tense confrontation into absolute chaos. What starts as a staredown quickly spirals into a violent backstage war filled with strikes, slams, shattered equipment, and pure adrenaline-fueled aggression. This isn’t “lazy AI content.” This is cinematic AI storytelling. Every frame was built to show how AI can be used creatively — combining wrestling-style worldbuilding, character design, atmosphere, motion, and visual storytelling into something that feels larger than life while still carrying personality and style. AIW focuses on: * original characters * cinematic fight choreography * wrestling-inspired storytelling * stylized action sequences * creative worldbuilding through AI tools Nyx Vale brings ruthless precision and cold intimidation. Astra Devi fights with raw power and relentless aggression. Only one walks out. #AIW #WomensWrestling #AIFight #BackstageBrawl #NyxVale #AstraDevi #AIArt #CinematicAI #FightScene #WrestlingInspired #aistorytelling #wwe #aiwrestling #aiwomen

title: Xiong xiong ai shang ni
description: Tiring of serving people, Peter, a tour guide, brings Teddy Bears that are considered as families or pets to their owners to travel abroad. On his way to pick up a Teddy Bear, a car accident happens. All 3 Bears are missing. To stall for time and money, Peter tries to compensate customers, grandpa and grandma Ju who treat Teddy Bear as their son, Mrs. Wang who believes by sending beloved bear to a trip will cure Xiao-Mei's incurable disease, Selina who treats Teddy Bear as boyfriend, with mini bears. Xiao-Mei takes advantage of Peter's fear of Yah-Ke, GrandpaJu's son, and manipulates him to accompany Xiao-Mei to find her father. She also makes Grandpa and Grandma Ju persuading Selina who suffers from depression into driving them to the beach where Xiao-Mei's father lives. A group of people, who are bound together because of Teddy Bears, step on an unexpected journey.

title: Ai Tenchi Muyo!
description: A reboot of the Tench Muyo anime In TV short form. The Series takes place in the city of Takahashi, the real-life sponsor of the show.

description: Since she was a child, 26-year-old Hanako Orimura has dreamed of becoming a movie director. Now, she is on the verge of making her debut as a movie director. description: A young and rich widow hires an unemployed man, Pietro, to make him live with her and to let everybody believe he is her lover. Pietro, to gain his dignity back, moves away to look for a more decent job. He unexpectedly inherits a fortune from America that makes him suddenly a wealthy man. He goes back to the widow just in time to prevent her from marrying the wrong man.

title: The Last Buffalo
description: For thousands of years, the Great Plains were home to countless numbers of American bison, but in the late 1800s, the number of bison dropped from nearly 30 million to just a few hundred in less than 100 years. What happened to place this national icon on the brink of extinction? Join us as we detail the events that led to this mass extermination. Then follow the story of William Temple Hornaday, a chief taxidermist at the Smithsonian Institution who headed west to hunt bison for the museum, but ended up saving the species instead.

title: The Secret Garden
description: A taut psychological thriller, The Secret Garden stars AJ Cross as Peter Sebastian, a lone spy who must face a global threat that may wreak havoc upon all Americans. Based on the story The Garden of Forking Paths, The Secret Garden is a classic spy movie with all the trappings of a classic spy novel. Full of intrigue and contrivance, The Secret Garden brings a classic spy hero to life who must face the ultimate challenge- to avert a nuclear war and rely solely on his survival skills to cope with his mission. Peter must act fast to stop the terrorists before they are able to carry out their devious plan. Will Peter win out in the end? Or will the terrorists get the upper hand? Find out in this highly intense original movie that is the standard of all spy movies. And unite for a hero that will live on as the ultimate spy reconnoiter since the advent of James Bond.

description: On a weekend camping trip, two struggling couples are haunted by La Patasola, a famed vampiric monster from Amazonian folklore, testing their relationships, morality, and will to survive.

title: Yudh
description: The central premise of Yudh is based on around the story of a young girl Pavitra, who is kidnapped from a park and never heard off again. Her grieving parents have spent their lives trying to come to terms with the loss of their child. The story then shifts to offering other perspectives to this incident, through the eyes of Satan and of God. In essence, the story implies that the war between Satan and God is now fought in the minds of humans, with both of them trying to exert their influence on the human. It concludes that the winner of this war between God and Satan is eventually determined in the human mind, even though humans may not be aware of this eternal battle, or the reason why they have to endure suffering for no fault of theirs.

title: Ugly S1-S2
description: Meryem, who lost her family early and is known as "Ugly," reunites with her childhood love Kadir after years. This encounter brings passionate love and a harsh reckoning with the past.

title: The Prophet
description: The Prophet tells a fictional story of a woman named Devaduta, following her life from her adolescence through to her last days. Devaduta is born in poverty, and her childhood is marred by unending toil, and her relationship with an abusive father - a drunkard and a child abuser. At one point, Devaduta starts hearing a voice that she identifies as the 'Voice of God'. She escapes from her home, to find employment as a cleaner at a dance academy. The guru at this academy identifies a spark in her and trains her, to see her blossom into a danseuse par excellence. With her fame and fortunes, Devaduta goes on to build an Ashram to help needy children, while being constantly guided by the 'Voice of God'. Her social work and the fact that she hears 'the Voice of God' gets her the epithet of 'The Prophet' from the people. However one day the voice tells her she has a year to live, and this realization completely shatters the equanimity of Devaduta. The story goes on to explore the relevance of a Prophet in a world deemed to be created without hierarchies by God.

title: Al-Heiba Al-Rad
description: As Jabal returns to his regular life after his assassination attempt and the loss of his wife and son, he does his best to find the culprits, only to uncover unexpected information with severe consequences.

title: Al Leqaa Al Thani
description: A series of separate-connected episodes that deal with men's relationship with women within different contexts. As life separate them, only for them to be reunited to reflect on their past and the events they went through.

title: Al Mashhad Al Akhir
description: Ammar is an aspiring director who is trying to produce his dream movie. Despite all the obstacles that impede him, he persists in fighting alongside Rana, who was unable to hold onto a job for long due to her managers' harassment.

title: Qawaed Al Talaq Al 45
description: After their divorce, three women struggle against society's stereotypes and its view of divorced women, and each of them turns from being a woman in her forties facing divorce in an Eastern society to a woman facing society; meanwhile, they endeavor to get the happy life they deserve and search for the means of happiness in romantic relationships.

title: Al-Mara'a wa Al-Satour
description: From alexandria,An infamous murder case in the 90's,Where a woman kills her con artist and abusive new husband and cuts him to slices to escape her torment and save her teenage daughter from him.

title: Al Moharej
description: A very complex murder occurs, and many accused appear, each with evidence linking him to the crime. It starts a maze of search and anticipation until the shocking truth is reached after a journey of surprises.

title: Al Maddah
description: Saber Al Maddah is a religious man who is well-loved among his people. But when he falls in love, he loses everything in a moment of uncontrollable rage after he kills the closest person to his beloved, thus turning his life upside down.

title: Al-Nassabeen Al-Thalatha
description: Hosni inherited an enormous wealth. Abbas and the dancer Nahed show up and try to take control on his money, however, Ghawar, Hosni's driver, decides to help him, so he makes them believe, through comic dumps, that he is the beneficiary from this money. He transforms everybody to servants working for him. Anotther Ghawar comedy starring Duraid Lahham and Nihad Qali that brings in the usual laughs.

title: Al Maddah 5: Ostorat Al Ahd
description: In Season 5, Saber El-Maddah returns from the dead to face new demonic threats-this time, the daughters of Iblis. As he fights their evil plans, his personal life takes unexpected turns.

title: Al Ens Wa Al Jinn
description: Fatima returns from America after earning her doctorate, she meets Galal who works as a tourist agent. When she returns home, she finds Galal in her bedroom and warns her from marrying Osama her fiancé, he tells her that he is a demon who is in love with her. Fatima refuses Galal's request and orders him to stay away from her as she is the only person who can see him.

title: Al Dhakira al Khasba
description: The first full length film to be shot within the occupied Palestinian West Bank "Green Line," FERTILE MEMORY is the feature debut of Michel Khleifi, acclaimed director of the Cannes Film Festival triumph, WEDDING IN GALILEE. Lyrically blending both documentary and narrative elements, Khleifi skillfully and lovingly crafts a portrait of two Palestinian women whose individual struggles both define and transcend the politics that have torn apart their homes and their lives.

title: Al Interior
description: The story of four different people who live in the same territory is interlaced, each one with their own social position and their own needs and interests. They, without knowing it, will be wrapped in the same history because of an object in whose interior is put the hope of each one and which will change their lives forever.

title: Al-Taraaef Al-Ghareeba
description: Funny tales drawn from folklore and includes a large group of songs that correspond to the content of each tale.

title: Al Hessa Al Akheera
description: Al Hessa Al Akheera

title: Al Hana Al Ana Feeh
description: The events revolve around the character of Dr. Ahmed, who is interested in giving advice to his followers about building personality and marital happiness on social media, while he faces problems in his marital life and is surprised when his wife offers her friend to marry him.

title: Al-Hob Wa Al-Salam
description: Across two time periods, the series chronicles life in Syria and the harsh circumstances that the Syrian people lived through during the first Gulf War and during the state of siege the country went through under the reign of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party.

title: Al-La'na
description: Hamdy is a journalist who arrives to a mental hospital posing as a mentally ill person to look for a scoop related to the death of a mental patient. Some changes occur in his personality as a result of his integration with the other patients but he soon discovers the killer's identity.

title: exception(al)
description: When her film professor extends unwanted attention toward her, a young Asian American student grapples with what it means to be the only woman of color in her class.

title: Al Fonduq
description: A social drama that depicts the life at the Iraqi society through a symbolic hotel that represents the society with its different classes as they interact and encounter challenges.

title: Al Dewaniya
description: A daily talk-show that talks about the Kuwaiti community and it's issues in a comedic way.

title: Al-Tareek Al-Da'ery
description: In a country where corruption has reached epidemic levels, an investigative journalist tries to reveal a medical mogul's corruption that caused the deaths of dozens without blame. Essan's daughter has kidney failure and has been affected by the filters this mogul's factory makes. Essam's marriage is stale because of their daughter's sickness and he finds himself lured by an attractive seductress. When Essam can't pay for a kidney transplant for his daughter, he wonders if he should become corrupt herself in order to save her life. And what must he do to save his marriage and reputation?

title: Al gharib al saghir
description: The film follows the journey of a young boy from childhood to adolescence, as he begins to feel manhood growing inside of him, while the world around him treats him as a young child. He starts doing grown-up work, falls in love with a girl, and gradually steps into the troubled world of adults.

title: Al Ameel
description: It follows two brothers, Amir and Wissam, who have been separated by fate since childhood. Amir grows up to become a police officer, who infiltrates a gang as part of a secret operation. While Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together and their fates are intertwined.

title: Al Ayam Al Moutamarida
description: The events revolve around the period in which Al-Shishakli's rule fell in Syria, especially in the Qalamoun countryside, by depicting the impact of the change on local, Arab and international events, as the fall of Al-Shishakli brought Hashim Al-Atassi back to power.

title: Al jababira
description: The two boxing champions Jean and Andre Saade are facing international sportsmen in order to win big championships. But a conspiracy is being prepared against them. Will they be able to face all their enemies?

title: Al Wahm
description: Magdy, an engineer who gets traumatized after witnessing a worker fall to his death from a building . He decides to visit Alexandria to recover, and there he meets Soad, who suffers from a pale relationship with her husband.

title: Al margen
description: Documentary that tells the story of Moisés, a man who set himself on fire in the heart of Madrid in 2010, making headlines that barely outlined the reasons for his tragic decision.

title: Al Garib
description: In occupied Golan Heights, a desperate unlicensed doctor subverts his village's expectations when he accidentally encounters a wounded soldier from the war in Syria.

title: I am here!
description: At the height of the demonstrations during the Abadan shipyard workers' strike, Amir's body is found in a canal in circumstances that leave much open to doubt. Ibrahim, Amir's brother must now not only look after his aging mother, but also Salwa, his brother's young and beautiful widow, for whom he has unexpressed feelings. The employer's lawyer offers the family cash if they agree not to sue the shipyard, but Ibrahim's mother and the striking workers are against any deal. title: I am Special
description: I AM SPECIAL is an 2017 film based on the real life stories of six differently able persons written, edited and directed by Priyakanta Laishram. Priyakanta Laishram talked about the struggles, strength, courage and willpower of his deceased mother who was suffering from Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Also the film dealt with the stories of people who have other motor neuron disease, bipolar disorder and others. The film went on to win prestigious awards such as Best Educational Film, Audience Choice Award, Out Of The Box Award at several national and international level film festivals. It is also the first English speaking film made by a Manipuri in record.

title: I Am Bish
description: The film appears at first to be a documentary. Bish, a final year film student, is shooting the documentary for his graduating project. Things change when an unspecified "incident" wipes out the population of Western Australia leaving Bish as the only survivor. At first he enjoys his new found wealth and power, stealing cars, playing golf in expensive mansions and breaking into an Army base to steal an arsenal of weaponry including a Field Gun which he uses to shell the houses of people he didn't like when they were alive. Bish is just starting to become lonely when the zombies arrive and he finds a new lease of life in the challenge of survival. He is preparing to leave Perth when he makes contact with another survivor, Sarah, on the other side of town and he finds the true purpose that had eluded him in his former life - to get to Sarah and get her out of the city. However as the city is now overflowing with zombies this proves to be more than a little difficult.

title: Havoc an Anime
description: In the coastal city of Ferrithon, once known as Edenburg, perfection is an illusion carefully maintained by a system built on control, fear, and hidden corruption. Beneath its thriving skyline and peaceful exterior lies a network of power that manipulates truth and silences opposition. Cyrus, a disciplined and fearless police officer, serves as one of the last symbols of justice in a broken system. Known for his efficiency and unwavering moral code, he protects the people of Ferrithon while unknowingly operating within a corrupt structure. His life is grounded by his wife Laura, a former army doctor whose strength and compassion offer him balance in an increasingly unstable world. However, everything begins to change when Cyrus uncovers fragments of the truth behind the city's leadership. At the center of this system is Victor, a calculating and emotionless ruler who seized power by killing his own father and reshaping the city into a controlled empire. A brilliant scientist, Victor conducts secret experiments to evolve humanity, viewing individuals as expendable components in a larger design. As Cyrus moves closer to exposing the truth, he becomes a target. A series of orchestrated events leads to the apparent loss of his wife, pushing him into emotional collapse. Consumed by grief and rage, he is drawn into a hidden program that promises strength but conceals a far darker purpose. Within a secret facility, Cyrus undergoes brutal experimentation, granting him enhanced regenerative abilities tied to fluid absorption and augmenting his body with partial mechanical strength. The transformation changes him. No longer bound by law or restraint, Cyrus escapes and unleashes chaos upon the very system he once served. As he tears through criminal networks and corrupt forces, the city begins to fracture under his actions. To some, he becomes a symbol of justice. To others, a monster. Amid the destruction, a young scientist named Arlos emerges, offering Cyrus a chance to stabilize and evolve his abilities further. Together, they uncover deeper layers of Victor's plans, including contact with extraterrestrial forces that threaten to reshape the future of humanity itself. As tensions rise, Cyrus learns that not everything he believed is true. Hidden truths about his wife and the system force him to question his path. title: An Ordinary Martyr
description: "An Ordinary Martyr, the Life and Death of Blessed Stanley Rother," tells the story of a young man born into a devout German-Catholic family in the small farming town of Okarche, Oklahoma. His calling to the priesthood and missionary service led him to Guatemala where he would give his life for his people. This short film captures the heart, devotion, and resolution of Blessed Stanley Rother and the ultimate sacrifice he made for his faith. Stanley Francis Rother was beatified in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, on Sept. 23, 2017. Beatification is the last step on the path to sainthood in the Catholic Church. Blessed Stanley Rother showed with his life, and eventual martyrdom, that "the shepherd cannot run at the first sign of danger."

title: Haie an Bord
description: One day the dive instructor Fred Norman, who works at a jet-set resort on the Costa Smeralda, is approached by Andrea Jacobs. She is the girl-friend of the gangster Harry Lang. Some years ago, both have the cash of a transport robbery sink into the sea, to secure this stolen money for their fellow gangsters. Jacobs and Lang force Norman to assist them to appear the gold. There is tension on board of the fishing cutter, which attempts to discover the loot. Especially, when the operation appears to be much harder than expected. Furthermore, an ex-partner of both gangsters, Paul Barko, is trailing the trio.

title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: River of No Return
description: This legendary tale, set on the Grand Canal, recounts the desperate journey of a crown prince, a minor constable, a female doctor, and a minor official-a fate that leaves no one immune. Constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and minor official Yu Qian must escort Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji from Nanjing back to Beijing within 15 days. Each with their own agenda, they embark on a journey evading ambushes and pursuers. Dodging danger and overcoming obstacles along the way, they ultimately rediscover themselves, each other, and the world.

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.
